title: Strip Secrets
statement: Implement `solve(row)`. `row` is a dict. Remove `password_hash` and `internal_note` if present. Return the remaining dict.
hints: Copy and drop those two names.
Do not blank the values and leave the keys.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A response model is an allow-list.

editorial: A response model is an allow-list. Deleting known secret keys is the same idea when you are looking at a raw row in a test. Leaving the key with a blank value still tells the client the field exists. Delete the key.
